label: PF Backlog 584
title: Backlog API: no deterministic endpoint to author item context fields (objective/acceptance_criteria/affected_files/approach)
body: The take-up requirement 'author item context, all fields, via API' is not achievable: the only context-writing endpoints are POST /items/{id}/groom (AI-dependent; ai_failed with no live model) and .../analysis (status/architecture_fit/implementation_strategy only). core.backlog.update(scope,project,eid,**fields) already writes authored fields, but is not exposed. Fix: add POST /backlog/items/{id}/context -> core.backlog.update with a whitelist of authored-context fields (deterministic, no AI). Found during BI-PF-1372 take-up.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend the existing /api/v1/backlog router in components exposing core/backlog.py with a new deterministic POST /backlog/items/{id}/context endpoint that validates a whitelist of authored-context fields (objective, acceptance_criteria, affected_files, approach, plus scope/project/eid resolution) and delegates to core.backlog.update(scope, project, eid, **fields). Reuse existing request/response conventions from sibling endpoints (/backlog/groom, /backlog/ids:reserve); add a Pydantic (or equivalent) schema for the whitelist and a thin validation layer. No AI calls. Wire into API smoke tests already covering the backlog router.
dependency_findings: REQUIRES core/backlog.update to accept and persist authored-context fields (already true per item body).
BLOCKS BI-PF-1195 deterministic path for full-context population on items.
RELATED BI-PF-0337 (core PF APIs) and BI-0083 (API smoke test) for coverage conventions.
conflict_findings: BI-PF-1195 may concurrently touch the backlog router/grooming path — coordinate to avoid route/schema merge conflicts.
No other listed in-flight task modifies the same endpoint surface.
duplication_findings: No existing deterministic context-authoring endpoint; /groom is AI-gated and /analysis writes only status/architecture_fit/implementation_strategy.
BI-PF-1195 covers grooming completeness but not a dedicated deterministic authoring API; ensure it consumes this endpoint rather than duplicating it.
Candidate API list shows no POST context route under /api/v1/backlog.
analysis.rationale: Smallest deterministic fix that satisfies the take-up requirement by reusing core.backlog.update behind a new, AI-free REST route; no new components needed and no architecture drift.
assumptions: core.backlog.update(scope, project, eid, **fields) is importable and stable from the API layer.
The API layer can resolve item id -> (scope, project, eid) via existing backlog lookup helpers.
Deterministic writes are acceptable without triggering re-analysis or AI hooks.
risks: Field whitelist could drift from core.backlog.update's accepted fields — mitigate with a single shared constant derived from the core signature/schema.
Existing clients might expect AI enrichment on context writes; document deterministic-only semantics.
Auth/permissions model for mutating backlog items may be undefined on this route.
evidence: Backlog item body cites exact code path core.backlog.update and confirms it is unexposed.
Candidate APIs list confirms absence of a context-authoring route under /api/v1/backlog.
Found during BI-PF-1372 take-up: /groom returns ai_failed with no live model; /analysis is field-limited.
missing_info: Exact whitelist of authored-context fields beyond the four named (e.g., priority, deps) — confirm scope boundary.
Desired response shape/status codes and whether partial updates (PATCH semantics) are allowed.
Auth/permission requirements for the mutation endpoint.
Whether the endpoint should emit a change-audit record or trigger downstream preflight/validation.

context_review.reason: Problem and approach narrative are clear (add POST /backlog/items/{id}/context delegating to core.backlog.update with a field whitelist), but AFFECTED_COMPONENTS, AFFECTED_FILES, and APPROACH/ACCEPTANCE fields are placeholders ('Not specified'/restated title), so the implementer must dig to find where the backlog API routes live and which fields to whitelist.

api_impact.reason: retrofit assessment (ADR-0007): no external API consumer recorded; treated as internal until an API surface is required (then set needs_api=true with routes)
